senses.gloss: = h. תַּחַת, under, beneath, in place of.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 10:7">Targ. Ps. X, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 19:17">Targ. Y. Ex. XIX, 17</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:21">Targ. O. ib. II, 21</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. IV, 7ᵃ top <he>חשבון … תּוֹחֲתֵי רשיכון וכ׳</he> have in mind to put them under your heads, and you may move them (on the Sabbath); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 5:1:1">Y. Bets. V, beg. 62ᵈ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:1:18-19">Y. Snh. I, 18ᵇ</cite> top <he>אייתו … תְּחוֹתַי לדיקלא וכ׳</he> get me a person to go up the tree (to work) in my place, and I will judge your case; a. fr.—Contr. <he>תּוֹת</he>.
